---
title: "A {gt} table changes its identifier on every render"
ref: ERR-04
categories: [Errors and files]
impact: incoherent
attendu: "the same HTML for the same table"
versions: "All versions of {gt}"
source: "Slack ThinkR (2024)"
---

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
library(gt)
tab <- data.frame(x = 1)
html_1 <- as.character(as_raw_html(gt(tab), inline_css = FALSE))
html_2 <- as.character(as_raw_html(gt(tab), inline_css = FALSE))
identical(html_1, y = html_2)
regmatches(html_1, m = regexpr('id="[^"]*"', text = html_1))
regmatches(html_2, m = regexpr('id="[^"]*"', text = html_2))
```

```text
[1] FALSE
[1] "id=\"fsqsscaaxf\""
[1] "id=\"eyncbpbvfg\""
```
:::

This pitfall depends on the {gt} package, so it cannot be replayed in the browser.

## Why

To keep a table's styling from leaking onto the other tables of the page, {gt} wraps each table in a block carrying an identifier, and prefixes all its CSS rules with that identifier. When you do not supply one, it draws one at random, at render time.

So two renders of the same table differ. A snapshot test fails on every run, and a report versioned in git changes on every build. On top of that, the draw advances the random number generator: the numbers drawn later in the script are no longer the same.

## The remedy

Give a fixed identifier with the `id` argument. Failing that, `withr::with_seed()` freezes the draw without touching the generator of the rest of the script.

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
html_1 <- as.character(as_raw_html(gt(tab, id = "sales"), inline_css = FALSE))
html_2 <- as.character(as_raw_html(gt(tab, id = "sales"), inline_css = FALSE))
identical(html_1, y = html_2)

render_table <- function() {
  withr::with_seed(seed = 1, code = as.character(as_raw_html(gt(tab), inline_css = FALSE)))
}
identical(render_table(), y = render_table())
```

```text
[1] TRUE
[1] TRUE
```
:::
